subject.title: Allow owners and authors to delete messages

question: Should workspace ownership grant deletion authority inside private direct conversations when the owner is not a conversation participant?
rationale: Source inspection cannot determine the intended privacy contract; either choice defines a security-sensitive workspace policy that must be explicit before implementation is finalized.

options.title: Keep DMs participant-scoped
options.body: Allow owners to delete channel messages, but require DM membership or authorship before deleting a direct-message entry.

options.title: Grant owners DM authority
options.body: Permit workspace owners to delete private-DM messages, with explicit product documentation and proof covering the resulting privacy expectations.

recommendation.title: Keep DMs participant-scoped
recommendation.body: Allow owners to delete channel messages, but require DM membership or authorship before deleting a direct-message entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the workspace-wide authorization and private-conversation contract, making the project lead the best available decision owner.
